behavior_under_test: A client can read a bodyless HTTP/1.0 response without Content-Length and without a method field on the response start line.
ground_truth_basis: The evaluator performs a real local socket round trip and checks the received status and empty body. It uses status 204 and different response bytes from the historical 200-response regression test.
independence: Independent evaluator test adapted from the HTTP/1.x framing contract, with a different status/body shape and no copied historical assertions.
limitations: The check uses loopback sockets and requires the evaluator host to permit local socket creation.
